item.title: AgentsView: local analytics for your coding agents
item.description: AgentsView is an open-source tool that indexes sessions from 20+ coding agents into a local SQLite database, providing analytics dashboards, cost tracking, and full-text search without sending data off your machine.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: Kooha: Simple and Elegant Screen Recording on Linux
item.description: Discover Kooha, a minimalist screen recording application for Linux that combines ease of use with essential features.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro
